correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the multiplication matrices over F3[x]/(x^4+x^3+x^2+1), irreducibility, dim(S)=4, dim(U)=12 and Frobenius orthogonality. Every nonzero rank-one uv^T cannot be orthogonal to all multiplication maps because as a ranges over F81, M_a v spans F3^4; so U has no rank-one matrix. An independently structured rank computation evaluated all 130 projective 2-planes N: the restrictions Mv=0 on K always have rank 8 from dim(K)=10. Each 2-dimensional annihilator therefore contains exactly 3^2-1=8 nonzero matrices of rank exactly 2; distinct rank-2 matrices have unique right kernels, so 1040 in total. This verifies the exact necessary plane balance, not the unresolved lift equation. The source program also states a full U rank distribution, but these independent checks need only the rank-one exclusion.
